say.say: Up to eight hundred different car parts.

say: One AI model sorts them all.
And it learned the job in simulation.

beats.name: AXIS ROBOTICS
beats.tagline: The compounding data engine for physical AI
say: Meet Axis Robotics, a data engine for robots.
This week, it announced a commercial partnership with Lotus Cars and Geely.
It simulates the production line, trains the sorting policy there, then deploys it on the real line.

beats.head: Study · 7 Oct 2026
beats.setup: Franka Research 3 · 3 tasks · 10 real demos each

say.say: Why simulation? In Axis's own study, a real arm with ten demos per task succeeded sixteen point seven percent of the time.
say.show: Why simulation? In Axis's own study, a real arm with 10 demos per task succeeded 16.7% of the time.

say.say: Six hundred simulated runs, picked by its method TUCO, took it to eighty-five point eight. All twelve hundred only reached twenty-five point eight.
say.show: 600 simulated runs, picked by its method TUCO, took it to 85.8%. All 1,200 only reached 25.8%.

say.say: Its data comes from people: more than one hundred thousand contributors, Axis says, steering robots in their browsers.
say.show: Its data comes from people: more than 100,000 contributors, Axis says, steering robots in their browsers.

say.say: And in Singapore for Token twenty forty-nine week, it brought two humanoid robots to O K X's rooftop party.
say.show: And in Singapore for TOKEN2049 week, it brought two humanoid robots to OKX's rooftop party.

beats.head: Built by all.
say: Robot intelligence isn't built by a few. It's built by all. Follow for more.
